partition_policy.training: all target facts except source-exclusive validation and blind facts

results.name: GeneticsKP disease-activity corroborated target inhibition
results.hypothesis: Inhibition of a top-three disease gene is more credible when GOA says the gene enables a molecular activity independently associated with the disease by GeneticsKP.
results.body: Drug decreases a top-three disease gene; GOA and GeneticsKP connect its enabled molecular activity to the disease
results.mechanism_rationale: The rule adds an independent disease-activity-to-target bridge, but the activity association is unsigned and may reflect broad molecular functions.
results.trapi_notes: The positive graph motif is TRAPI-expressible; source constraints, disease-relative rank, source exclusion, and ontology constraints require post-processing.
results.cypher:
MATCH (activity:MolecularActivity)-[activity_evidence:GENETIC_ASSOCIATION]->
      (object:Disease)
MATCH (target:Gene)-[enables:ENABLES]->(activity)
MATCH (target)-[gene_evidence:MINER_GENE_DISEASE_EVIDENCE]->(object)
MATCH (subject:Drug)-[binding:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->
      (target)
MATCH (subject)-[effect:AFFECTS]->(target)
WHERE 'infores:geneticskp' IN
      coalesce(activity_evidence.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
  AND 'infores:goa' IN coalesce(enables.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
  AND effect.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND effect.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND effect.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND gene_evidence._miner_disease_rank <= 3
  AND none(
    source IN coalesce(binding.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
    WHERE source IN ['infores:drug-repurposing-hub', 'infores:ttd']
  )
  AND none(
    source IN coalesce(effect.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
    WHERE source IN ['infores:drug-repurposing-hub', 'infores:ttd']
  )
  AND coalesce(object._miner_disease_descendant_degree, 0) <= 500
  AND object._miner_disease_superclass_degree >= 1
  AND object.id STARTS WITH 'MONDO:'
RETURN DISTINCT subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id

results.name: GeneticsKP disease-activity target activation control
results.hypothesis: Increasing the same activity-corroborated top-three disease genes is a matched direction control for R413.
results.body: R413 graph architecture with increased target activity or abundance
results.mechanism_rationale: The activity evidence is unchanged while the intervention direction is reversed.
